query: SELECT ol.device_id, ol.seq, ol.op_type, ol.payload, ol.created_at, ol.is_replicated AS "is_replicated!: bool" FROM op_log ol WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR ol.op_type = ?1) AND (?2 IS NULL OR ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks sb WHERE sb.id = ol.block_id AND sb.space_id = ?2) OR ( ol.op_type IN ('delete_attachment', 'rename_attachment') AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attachments a JOIN blocks sb ON sb.id = a.block_id WHERE a.id = json_extract(ol.payload, '$.attachment_id') AND sb.space_id = ?2 ) OR ( ol.op_type = 'delete_attachment' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM op_log src_add JOIN blocks sb ON sb.id = src_add.block_id WHERE src_add.op_type = 'add_attachment' AND src_add.attachment_id = json_extract(ol.payload, '$.attachment_id') AND sb.space_id = ?2 ) ) ) ) )) ORDER BY ol.created_at DESC, ol.seq DESC, ol.device_id DESC LIMIT ?3
